name: isLifeCycleManagementEnabled
definition: True when accounts are provisioned and removed through a working joiner, mover and leaver process, evidenced by the access of people who have left being removed.
population: the accounts of people who have left or changed role in the systems in scope; denominator = every such account the read lists
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read showing no account of a person who has left remains active, or a passing test of the same fact over the full population.
citations: Validate proper provisioning and deprovisioning processes exist (integrationservice criteriakey-defaults.json)

safeguards/compliancemanagement/vanta/ and safeguards/compliancemanagement/drata/ islifecyclemanagementenabled.py (third-party proof sources: the GRC platform's own test result, level 3 in the proof ladder)

changeLog.change: Registered so the GRC-platform proof-source transforms can emit it. The meaning is the existing catalogue description made precise; the roughly twenty existing implementations in other categories were not reviewed, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Registered for the Vanta and Drata proof-source transforms. Those answer from a GRC platform's own test results (third-party proof, level 3), never from a read of the tool, so allowedCategories is empty (cross-category evidence). Whether the other implementations of this key measure the same thing is not ruled; that review is open and the owner is not yet named.
